name: SimpleQA
description: A short-form factual accuracy benchmark containing 4,326 questions with single, indisputable correct answers. Designed to measure factual accuracy and hallucination rates in a straightforward manner, with questions verified to have unambiguous ground truth. Google DeepMind released SimpleQA Verified (1,000 refined questions) in 2025 to fix quality issues.
typical_sota_score: ~39–60% (GPT-4o scored ~39% at launch; frontier models as of 2026 reach higher but hallucination remains significant)
reputation: Released by OpenAI in October 2024; used to measure factual grounding and hallucination in concise answers; SimpleQA Verified improves reliability
notes: Released October 2024. Surprisingly low accuracy for frontier models despite question simplicity, revealing persistent factual hallucination. SimpleQA Verified (1,000 questions, Google DeepMind 2025) fixes topic biases and incorrect labels from the original. Used in the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and tracked on major leaderboards for factual reliability.
